name: audial-mcp
description: Split stems, master tracks, build sample packs, convert audio to MIDI, make synth presets and generate music.
long_description: Audial's hosted audio tools inside your AI assistant. Point it at a file on your computer and it can split stems, analyze tempo and key, find song sections, master a mix, build a sample pack, transcribe to MIDI, generate music, turn one sound into a Vital or Serum 2 preset, or sing lyrics in a reference voice. The first job opens a sign-in page in your browser. Results are saved to a folder you choose.

tools.name: stem_split
tools.description: Split a track into separate instrument stems, optionally retimed and rekeyed.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Analyze a track: BPM, key, loudness and other characteristics.

tools.name: segment
tools.description: Detect song sections (intro, verse, chorus...) and analyze components within them.

tools.name: master
tools.description: Master a mix, optionally matching a reference track.

tools.name: generate_samples
tools.description: Extract a sample pack (one-shots and loops) from a track.

tools.name: generate_midi
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file to MIDI.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate music with the Audial music model.

tools.name: sound2vital
tools.description: Turn one isolated sound into an editable Audial Synth preset.

tools.name: sound2serum
tools.description: Turn one isolated sound into an editable Xfer Serum 2 preset.

tools.name: text2vox
tools.description: Synthesize a sung vocal (and MIDI) from lyrics, a melody and a reference voice.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Which Audial tools have a worker awake right now, and what a cold one will cost.

tools.name: pipeline_status
tools.description: Look up an Audial pipeline by id: its state, each step, and the outputs so far.

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: List previous Audial results in the results folder, newest first.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Show whether this computer is signed in to Audial, and as whom.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to Audial through the user's browser. Opens an approval page and waits for it.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Sign out of Audial on this computer and disconnect it from the account.

results_dir.title: Results folder
results_dir.description: Where Audial saves the files it makes.
